# ECN-2026-023 Change notice - Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-RR01

Reason for change
- Replacement of the lubricant specification to a Cascade-approved item to consolidate inventory and address supplier discontinuation of prior product. The lubricant part number for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) is CFW-LUB-724.  
- Update aligns maintenance practice with material compatibility assessment and reduces cross-plant SKU proliferation.

Affected items
- Installed asset: EQ-P2-L1-RR01 (Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1).  
- Consumable SKU: previous lubricant entries in maintenance storeroom records to be superseded by CFW-LUB-724.  
- Associated work instructions and checklists that reference the prior lubricant must be reviewed: see SOP-P2-L1-01 and SOP-P2-L1-02. Refer to SB-1030 for material safety and handling requirements.

Implementation
- Effective date: upon approvals below.  
- Operations and maintenance shall transition to CFW-LUB-724 during the next scheduled lubrication downtime for EQ-P2-L1-RR01. Inventory procurement will be initiated by storeroom upon sign-off.  
- Update BOM and asset record for EQ-P2-L1-RR01 to list CFW-LUB-724 as the approved lubricant. Revise SOP-P2-L1-01 and SOP-P2-L1-02 to reference CFW-LUB-724 and update any tooling or PPE notes as required; coordinate with document control to record revisions.  
- Technicians shall complete a single substitution verification run and log observations per SOP-P2-L1-02 before resuming standard production. Any adverse observations shall be documented and escalated to maintenance engineering.

Approvals
- Maintenance Engineering: ____________________ Date: __________  
- Plant Operations: ____________________ Date: __________  
- Document Control: ____________________ Date: __________

Related documents
- SB-1030  
- SOP-P2-L1-01  
- SOP-P2-L1-02
